item.title: Bulletin updated at 08:50 HKT 20/Aug/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will strengthen gradually in the next couple of days. The weather will improve with showers easing off over the coast of southern China. It will be very hot in the latter part of this week. The area of low pressure now to the west of Guam is expected to develop gradually in the next couple of days and move towards Luzon. It will then move across the northern part of the South China Sea, in the general direction of Hainan Island and its adjacent waters. However, its development over the South China Sea and its distance from the coast of Guangdong remain uncertain. Besides, the tropical cyclone over the East China Sea will move towards the seas west of Kyushu of Japan and weaken gradually today and tomorrow.
